name: M7.CompactCorrectness.run_zero
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (w : ℕ) (E : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial), M7.PrefixSector.ValidSector N E → ∀ (bases : Finset (M7.Action.Recipe N)) (fuel : ℕ) (root : ℤ), M7.RecoveryInstance.GoodBases w bases → root = M7.CompactGeneration.residual w E bases [] → root.toNat ≤ fuel → (M7.CompactGeneration.run w E fuel bases root).finalResidual = 0 ∧ (M7.CompactGeneration.run w E fuel bases root).fuelExhausted = false
context:
theorem M7.CompactCorrectness.residual_eq : ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (w : ℕ) (E : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial), ∀ (bases : Finset (M7.Action.Recipe N)) (p : List Bool), M7.CompactGeneration.residual w E bases p = M7.RecoveryInstance.count w E bases p := by
  intro N inst w E bases p
  rfl

theorem M7.CompactCorrectness.emission_eq : ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (w : ℕ) (E : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial), ∀ bases : Finset (M7.Action.Recipe N), (M7.CompactGeneration.emission w E bases).leaf = M7.RecoveryInstance.recoverLeaf w E bases ∧ insert (M7.CompactGeneration.emission w E bases).representative bases = M7.RecoveryInstance.insertedBases w E bases := by
  intro N inst w E bases
  constructor <;> rfl
guidance: This is actual original M7 compact generation correctness, using frozen CompactGeneration.run/generate and accepted RecoveryInstance. residual_eq and emission_eq unfold the SAME arithmetic count/sourceCount/Within/encode/path/endpoint/leaf definitions; no count oracle is added. The internal run cache root is permitted as an intermediate argument, but run_cache preserves equality to the actual residual and generate computes it concretely once. Induct fuel generalizing bases root. For positive branches accepted recovery gives a fresh actual leaf, GoodBases after insertion, and a strict decrease of the actual root.toNat. For run_zero the fuel bound and nonnegativity force zero at fuel 0; the positive step gives enough fuel for the next actual root. The nonpositive branch is zero by actual nonnegativity. run_records uses structural induction and the accepted actual emission action/inverse/stabilizer theorems; signature fields and stabilizer field are their literal definitions. run_disjoint/Nodup use freshness relative to current bases and the induction statement at inserted bases. run_leaves uses actual recovered root membership. generate discharges the empty-base invariant and uses exactly initial count.toNat fuel. generate_coverage combines final zero cache with accepted root_zero; generate_card uses frozen run_fold, Nodup and Finset/List fold insertion identities. Never assume a complete transversal, free count identity or successful exhaustion. These targets close anchored generation only; raw coverage, full default query, replay and original resource accounting remain downstream. Return tactic body only.
